Accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report is crucial for regulatory compliance, environmental protection, and public health monitoring. Here is a comprehensive set of instructions to guide you through the process:

### 1. Start with the Monitoring Records

**Gather Key Data:**
- **Time & Location:** Record the exact time and place of the air-quality monitoring. Include dates, times, and Global Positioning System (GPS) coordinates if available.
- **Monitoring Devices & Calibrations:** Document the types of monitoring devices used (e.g., gas chromatographs, optical remote sensing, etc.) and their calibration status. Ensure regular calibration of instruments for accuracy.
